planets.name: TOI-942 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-942 with a 10.2-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-942 c was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-942. Its orbit and size follow Wirth et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
